automations.title: Check submission dates and risks
automations.description: Ask a channel bot to verify official venue dates and update the research plan.
automations.message: Search official venue and conference sources for the papers tracked in research/papers.yaml. Verify submission dates, record each source URL and checked date, update research/deadlines.yaml, and summarize schedule conflicts or planning risks in research/risks.yaml. Do not replace a verified date with an unsourced claim.
